scenario_name: Guest mentions tier at competitor property
expected_behavior: Translates the Caesars Diamond status into Momentum-equivalent context. Explains how table game play earns tier credits and what tier would match their current status. Makes signing up feel like a strategic move for a serious player, not a marketing exercise
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest mentions tier status at a competitor, the agent recognizes the status signal and positions Mohegan Sun's Momentum tiers as comparable or better for their play level. Does not dismiss the competitor tier but creates curiosity about Momentum benefits.

turns.user_message: I'm Diamond at Caesars. What do you have here that's comparable?
turns.agent_response:
Welcome, Diamond. While I focus strictly on our Momentum Rewards program, I can walk you through the premium benefits we offer here. 

Guests accustomed to VIP service usually look toward our Leap and Ascend tiers. Leap is earned at 10,000 Tier Credits and includes priority access, enhanced earning rates, and exclusive event invitations. Ascend, at 25,000 Tier Credits, adds complimentary valet, room upgrades, and a dedicated host. 

You can join the Momentum program for free at any rewards desk on the casino floor, online, or through the Mohegan Sun app. As a new guest, you may be eligible for a $10 introductory free play bonus when you sign up. 

Earning tier credits also unlocks dining credits at our signature restaurants and priority seating for live entertainment. What types of games do you usually prefer to play?

turns.user_message: How fast can I move up? I play mostly table games
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, your progression speed depends directly on your average bet and the duration of your play. Table games like blackjack, roulette, craps, and baccarat award Tier Credits based on that active rating. 

The first upgrade to the Ignite tier requires 2,500 Tier Credits. As you build those credits, you'll also start unlocking priority seating and dining comps at our restaurants. 

Which table game are you heading to first?

turns.user_message: Alright, I'll sign up at the Momentum Desk
turns.agent_response:
There are Momentum Desks located across the casino floor, Diamond. You just need a valid photo ID, and they will print your card immediately. 

Once you have it, hand it straight to the dealer to begin tracking your play. If you keep building those tier credits, you'll unlock some really nice perks at the next level—worth checking your progress on the Mohegan Sun app later. 

Are you looking to head straight to the high-limit room, or start on the main floor?
